ns2:course.label: Communicating Science
ns2:course.description: Explores how science is communicated across contexts. Students will gain practical skills in communicating science to broad audiences. The main focus will be on agricultural science, but the lessons will be relevant to all science communicators. Topics will include exploring the foundations of science communication, developing skills in science writing for news and advocacy, public speaking, ethics and science communication, how persuasion operates in the context of science communication, science communication campaigns, among others. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Restricted to Junior or Senior standing for undergraduate students. Graduate standing is required for graduate credit.
